Dear [Sir](/person/1074)
I send the quotation with another still more to the purpose- but I should not put in two ds- as certainly Hampshire always calls the plant cli-ders.[^1] However no doubt there is authority.
I was sorry to drop the[ dictionary work](/topic/151) but occupations thickened on me so that I could not keep it up

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: The OED entry for \'clithers\' defined as \'Another name of the plant clivers or cleavers\' includes illustrative quotations from both [The Heir of Redclyffe](/book/15) and [The Herb of the Field](/book/17), both referring to the plant as ‘cliders’.
